title: <channel>/<build>/enums.json.gz (decompressed): the names the game gives some of its enums, by id

sounds.description: LevelSoundEventMap: each sound event's name, by id (gaps; an alias's id twice)

particles.description: ParticleTypeMap: each particle type's name, by id (gaps; an alias's id twice)

containers.description: Container::containerTypeMap: each container type's name (INVENTORY -1, CONTAINER 0), by id

instruments.description: The note block instruments' sounds, by instrument; none where the build keeps no table of them

mapDecorations.description: MapDecoration::Type as the game's reflection registers it (MarkerWhite 0), by id; none before 1.26.40

containerNames.description: ContainerCollectionNameMap: the containers item stack requests name, by ContainerEnumName

explorationMarkers.description: The decoration types exploration maps mark, each named by the feature it leads to, in the registry's order
